notes: Rows extend the sibling lane's 30 concepts with the revenue-ranked items, their unit economics and fulfillment route.
fulfillment 'dropship' means print on demand shipped by the partner to the customer; 'in-store' means a run bought into 169 W Green St, sold at the counter and shipped by the shop.
cost is the estimated landed unit cost in USD (for dropship, the partner's base cost before shipping); price is the proposed retail price in USD.
launch true means the item is in the six-month plan (waves 1 to 3, November 2026 to April 2027); false means park until the first items show sell-through.
Costs marked as estimates in 'why' need two supplier quotes before ordering; unit forecasts rest on the planning assumptions in the companion file.

rows.name: La Boîte Cœur, Noël 2026
rows.slogan: Twelve macarons in a navy tin with the red heart, hand-numbered on the base, edition of 150. Bring the tin back and the refill is $28.
rows.product: Stock round tin with a printed heart sleeve, 12 macarons inside
rows.why: Rank 1. Sells what the kitchen already makes at the moment people buy gifts, only $12 above twelve loose macarons at counter prices; Levain upsells a tin made to be treasured and Milk Bar sells its tins at $28 and $48. Tin and sleeve cost of $4 to $6 is an estimate.

rows.name: La Boîte Cœur, Saint-Valentin 2027
rows.slogan: The Valentine's lid, edition of 100, on sale from Monday February 1, 2027.
rows.product: Same tin, Valentine's sleeve, 12 macarons
rows.why: A new numbered edition each season turns one tin into a set people keep; Valentine's on a heart brand is the second gift peak in the window.

rows.name: La Boîte Cœur, empty collector tin
rows.slogan: The season's tin on its own, for the shelf or the next refill.
rows.product: Empty numbered tin
rows.why: The only tin product TikTok Shop can list as merchandise without food paperwork; ships from the shop.

rows.name: Les Mots Doux: Framboise chérie
rows.slogan: Framboise chérie, with the small red heart. On the back: Un éclair, s'il vous plaît. Ou deux.
rows.product: 12 oz natural canvas tote, two-color screen print
rows.why: Rank 2. Los Angeles treats totes as status (LA Magazine, Oct 8, 2026); best margin in the set; the dessert names are already the brand's voice. Landed cost of $6 to $9 is an estimate from a 2026 wholesale guide.

rows.name: Les Mots Doux: Caramel je t'aime
rows.slogan: Caramel je t'aime, with the small red heart, in indigo ink on natural canvas.
rows.product: 12 oz natural canvas tote, two-color screen print
rows.why: A second design starts the 'which one are you' set; 30% of Trader Joe's mini-tote buyers own five or more.

rows.name: Les Mots Doux: Citron ma passion
rows.slogan: Citron ma passion, the spring addition to the set.
rows.product: 12 oz natural canvas tote, two-color screen print
rows.why: Add only after the first two designs sell through; the remaining jar names (Noisette toujours, Chocolat mon amour) follow the same way.

rows.name: Golden Ticket gift box
rows.slogan: A gilded, numbered ticket to the Tuesday Masterclass, a heart pin and the chocolate tablet in a navy box.
rows.product: Printed foil ticket, envelope, enamel heart pin, rigid box around the existing $140 class pass
rows.why: Rank 3. Cost shown is the merch parts only. Each unit is a $140 sale the shop already offers; the box is what makes a class pass a present.

rows.name: Le Cœur Mystère
rows.slogan: Six pastry hearts and one rare Cœur d'Or. Which one is yours? Drop Saturday February 6, 2027, limit three.
rows.product: 1-inch soft enamel heart pin in a sealed navy box; six designs plus a gold rare, about 1 in 20
rows.why: Rank 4 and the item built to travel: reveal, collect the set, a rare piece, a date. Cost includes seven molds and boxes over about 380 pins (estimate from 2026 pin pricing). Keep the gold heart as rarity only, with no prize, unless counsel approves.

rows.name: Mug Cœur, counter
rows.slogan: White 11 oz mug, red inside like the heart, the logo heart on the side.
rows.product: 11 oz ceramic mug with color inside, bought in bulk from the print partner
rows.why: Rank 5. Same design as the online mug, bought at $8.11 falling to $6.81 at 100 units; no shipping breakage when sold at the counter.

rows.name: Mug Cœur, online
rows.slogan: The 15 oz heart mug, sold singly or as a set of two for $46.
rows.product: 15 oz white glossy mug, print on demand
rows.why: No stock risk on a fragile item; first mug ships for $6.69 and each extra for $3.50, so the set of two is the default listing. Damaged arrivals are reprinted by the partner.

rows.name: La Tasse du Salon
rows.slogan: The cup and saucer from the salon de thé, in a blush glaze, made in a run of 36 to 48.
rows.product: Handmade stoneware cup and saucer from a local potter
rows.why: Guests see it in use at the tables; matches Ladurée's $48 mug. Potters wholesale at about half of retail and take weeks per custom order; decide in February on wave 1 results.

rows.name: Le Bol du Matin
rows.slogan: A French café au lait bowl with the red heart under the rim.
rows.product: Handmade stoneware bowl, about 14 oz, from a local potter
rows.why: A very French object that photographs well with a croissant; an alternative to the cup and saucer for the spring potter run. Ask for a lead-free, food-safe glaze report.

rows.name: Le Nuancier des Macarons, Hiver 2026
rows.slogan: The season's macaron colors with their French names, like a paint swatch card. Numbered and signed, edition of 100.
rows.product: 11x14 archival print, local print run
rows.why: Rank 6. A new edition each season; numbering and signing cannot be done on demand. Reveal video: each shell piped in time-lapse until the chart is complete.

rows.name: Le Nuancier des Macarons, open edition
rows.slogan: The 8x10 chart for out-of-town fans.
rows.product: 8x10 matte poster, print on demand
rows.why: Long tail online at no stock risk; delivered cost $11.35 to $13.14 across three partners in October 2026.

rows.name: Cartes de la Vitrine
rows.slogan: Six postcards of the pastry case, one new card each month; $4 each or $18 for the set.
rows.product: Set of six 4x6 postcards
rows.why: Rank 8. Under $1 a card; Balthazar's month with Ami Paris put the brand on postcards. The point is the return visit, not the card.

rows.name: Le Carnet
rows.slogan: Six stamps, one for each visit with a postcard, and the seventh visit brings a box of six macarons.
rows.product: Folded stamp card printed with the postcard run
rows.why: Free with purchase; turns the postcard set into a frequency mechanic. El Pollo Loco reports member frequency up 13% after adding drops.

rows.name: Le Tablier de la Promo
rows.slogan: The Masterclass apron, indigo with the red heart at the pocket. Bundle: Masterclass plus apron for $160.
rows.product: Cotton canvas bib apron, embroidered
rows.why: Rank 7. Every class ends with a group photo in matching aprons; raises the value of a seat. Cost of $18 to $25 at 24 to 50 units is an estimate to quote.

rows.name: Pin de la Promo
rows.slogan: Promo n° 12: a numbered cohort pin only Masterclass alumni can buy.
rows.product: 1-inch hard enamel heart pin with a cohort number on the backing card
rows.why: A loyalty-tier exclusive; alumni also get blind-box drops 24 hours early. PinMart lists a 100-piece minimum for hard enamel.

rows.name: Casquette Pâtisserie Française
rows.slogan: Pâtisserie Française embroidered in indigo with the small red heart.
rows.product: Embroidered dad hat, print on demand
rows.why: Rank 9 with the crewneck. No cash tied up; Dominique Ansel sells its hats at $27 to $29. Shipping $4.49 for the first hat.

rows.name: Salon de thé, Old Pasadena
rows.slogan: Salon de thé, Old Pasadena, in correct French, small on the chest.
rows.product: Heavyweight crewneck sweatshirt, print on demand
rows.why: Sizes make stock risky, so print on demand; reference prices are $46 (Dominique Ansel) and $60 (Levain). Base cost is an estimate to confirm in the partner catalog.

rows.name: Le Verre de La Cave
rows.slogan: A stemless glass with the heart, sold with a glass of wine on Saturday nights.
rows.product: Printed or etched stemless wine glass
rows.why: Rank 10, wave 3 for the spring patio and pairing evenings; picked up, never shipped. Cost is an estimate to quote.

rows.name: Apéro à La Cave tote
rows.slogan: Apéro à La Cave, 3 à 9, mercredi à dimanche.
rows.product: 12 oz canvas tote, one-color print
rows.why: Gives the evening crowd its own object; wait until the bakery totes prove the format.

rows.name: Pasadena, 1er janvier
rows.slogan: A rose and a heart for New Year's morning in Pasadena, with the date and no event names.
rows.product: 1-inch soft enamel pin
rows.why: Fits the New Year morning pre-orders (OPPORTUNITIES item 6) but the lead time from today is tight; keep for January 2028 if the pins sell.

rows.name: Thé de la Maison
rows.slogan: The house blend in a navy tin, the cup the salon pours every afternoon.
rows.product: Labelled tea tin with a private-label blend
rows.why: Tins start at 12 units with about two weeks lead, but the tea needs a private-label supplier and food labels; Ladurée sells boxed tea at $36 to $39. Cost is an estimate.

rows.name: Le Torchon
rows.slogan: A tea towel printed with the vitrine's price cards in their gold frames.
rows.product: Cotton tea towel, screen printed
rows.why: Levain sells a collaboration dish towel at $14.95; a good class gift add-on later. Cost is an estimate.

rows.name: Croissant-cœur bag charm
rows.slogan: A croissant curled into a heart, for the bag you carry to the bakery.
rows.product: Soft PVC or plush bag charm on a clip
rows.why: Bag charms are the 2025 to 2026 trend (Jellycat's croissant charm at $28, Dunkin' charms at $58 to $68); follow-on to the blind box only if it sells out. Cost is an estimate.
